title: Smart Data Models - HSDS - ServiceAtLocation
description: A link between a service and a specific location. (Human Services Data Specification 3.3.1, object 'service_at_location': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json. Field names are kept verbatim (snake_case) except 'id' -> 'hsdsId'.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity (NGSI-LD): urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceAtLocation:<HSDS id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServiceAtLocation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hsdsId.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/id'. The identifier of the service at location entry. Each entry must have a unique identifier. HSDS field 'id', renamed because 'id' is reserved in NGSI-LD.

service_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/service_id'. The identifier of the service at a given location. In HSDS this is an HSDS identifier (uuid); here it holds the URN of the Service entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Service:<HSDS id>).

location_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/location_id'. The identifier of the location where this service operates. In HSDS this is an HSDS identifier (uuid); here it holds the URN of the Location entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Location:<HSDS id>).

description.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/description'. A free text description of the service at this specific location.

service_areas.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/service_areas'. The details of the geographic area for which a service is available.

contacts.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/contacts'. The details of the named contacts for services and organizations.

phones.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/phones'. The details of the telephone numbers used to contact organizations, services, and locations.

schedules.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/schedules'. The details of when a service or location is open. Entries are RFC 5545 RRULES.

attributes.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/attributes'. A link between a service and one or more classifications that describe the nature of the service provided.

metadata.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service_at_location.json#/properties/metadata'. A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Not an HSDS field (Smart Data Models addition): a GeoJSON Point [longitude, latitude] copied from the latitude/longitude of the linked HSDS location (location_id), so that services can be found with NGSI-LD geo-queries. The embedded HSDS 'location' object is not kept (see location_id).

schedule.title: schedule
schedule.description: The details of when a service or location is open. Entries are RFC 5545 RRULES. (HSDS object 'schedule': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/schedule.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier for the schedule. Each entry must have a unique identifier.

service_id.title: Service Identifier
service_id.description: The identifier of the service for which this is the regular schedule

location_id.title: Location Identifier
location_id.description: The identifier of the location for which this is the regular schedule

service_at_location_id.title: Service At Location Identifier
service_at_location_id.description: The identifier of the ‘service at location’ table entry, when this schedule is specific to a service in a particular location.

valid_from.title: Valid From
valid_from.description: The date from which the schedule information is valid. It must be in the ISO 8601 format of YYYY-MM-DD, (HSDS tabular type: date.)

valid_to.title: Valid To
valid_to.description: The last date on which the schedule information is valid. It must be in the ISO 8601 format of YYYY-MM-DD. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

dtstart.title: Date Start
dtstart.description: iCal - The date of the first event is the schedule. Necessary when using the ‘interval’ feature, optional otherwise. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The timezone that all dates are expressed as, expressed as a UTC offset. Dates are assumed to be UTC otherwise.

until.title: Until
until.description: iCal - The date of the last occurrence of the recurring event. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

count.title: Count
count.description: iCal - The number of times that the event occurs. Use this instead of ‘until’, if appropriate.

wkst.title: Week Start
wkst.description: iCal - The two-letter code for the day on which the week starts: `MO`, `TU`, `WE`, `TH`, `FR`, `FR`, `SA`, `SU`

freq.title: Frequency
freq.description: iCal - How often the frequency repeats. Values can be `WEEKLY` or `MONTHLY`

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: iCal - How often the frequency repeats. For example, and Interval of 2 for a WEEKLY Frequency would represent fortnightly.

byday.title: By Day
byday.description: iCal - Comma separated days of the week. Where freq is MONTHLY each part can be preceded by a positive or negative integer to represent which occurrence in a month; e.g. 2MO is the second Monday in a month. -1FR is the last Friday

byweekno.title: By Week Number
byweekno.description: iCal - Comma separated numeric weeks of the year, where freq is WEEKLY. Can be negative to represent weeks before the end of the year; e.g. -5 is the 5th to last week in a year.

bymonthday.title: By Month Day
bymonthday.description: iCal - Comma separated numeric days of the month, where frequency is MONTHLY. Can be negative to represent days before the end of the month; e.g. -5 is the 5th to last day in a month.

byyearday.title: By Year Day
byyearday.description: iCal - Comma separated numeric days of the month, where frequency is YEARLY. Can be negative to represent days before the end of the year; e.g. -1 is the last day in a year.

description.title: Description
description.description: A free text description of the availability of the service.

opens_at.title: Opens At
opens_at.description: The time when a service or location opens. This should use HH:MM format and should include timezone information, either adding the suffix ‘Z’ when the date is in UTC, or including an offset from UTC (e.g. 09:00-05:00 for 9am EST.) (HSDS tabular type: time.)

closes_at.title: Closes At
closes_at.description: The time when a service or location closes. This should use HH:MM format and should include timezone information, either adding the suffix ‘Z’ when the date is in UTC, or including an offset from UTC (e.g. 09:00-05:00 for 9am EST.). (HSDS tabular type: time.)

schedule_link.title: Schedule Link
schedule_link.description: URL of a link for the schedule which may show each individual session and may provide a booking facility.

attending_type.title: Attending Type
attending_type.description: A free text description of how to attend this service.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free text notes on the schedule.

group.title: Group
group.description: A string label acting as a group identifier, allowing different schedules to be grouped together. For example, two schedules with the group `regular-hours` would be grouped separately from two schedules with the label `holiday-schedule`. The value of this field does not need to be readable or meaningful to humans, but it is recommended to make it so.
